name: Infallible Mind
label: Quest
description: Infallible Mind: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Your focused concentration has dwindled so soon? More research must be done!
Oh yes, the price remains the same, friend. Venture forth into the blasted lands and return to me with ten brains from the redstone and two vulture gizzards.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you returned with the requested organs?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, yes, give me a moment and more of the compound will be ready for your consumption, friend.
Take it... And friend, do not attempt to consume these experimental concoctions in rapid succession. The results could be disastrous.
